description: Defines the CordRepCrc structure and related functions for handling CRC nodes in a cord tree, including functions to remove and skip CRC nodes, and accessors for CRC data.

classes.name: CordRepCrc
classes.description: A specialized CordRep node that associates an expected CRC with contained data, used at the top level of a cord tree.

methods.name: CordRepCrc::New
methods.description: Creates a new CordRepCrc node with a child and CRC state.

methods.name: RemoveCrcNode
methods.description: Removes the outer CordRepCrc wrapper from a node if present, managing reference counts.

methods.name: SkipCrcNode
methods.description: Returns the child of a CordRepCrc node or the node itself if not a CRC node.

methods.name: CordRep::crc
methods.description: Accessor to cast a CordRep to a CordRepCrc, asserting it is a CRC node.
